sections.title: Healthcare Technology (Intermountain Health)
sections.description: Intermountain Health (Salt Lake City HQ, 33 hospitals across Utah, Idaho, Nevada, and Colorado) — consistently ranked among the US's most innovative health systems.

blocks.heading: Value-based care and clinical analytics
paragraphs: Intermountain has pioneered value-based care delivery in the Mountain West — ML for care gap identification, readmission prediction, and population health stratification for Intermountain's large insured and uninsured patient population.

blocks.heading: Genomics and precision medicine
paragraphs: Intermountain Precision Genomics is one of the most advanced genomics programs in the US mountain region — ML for pharmacogenomics, hereditary cancer risk prediction, and genomic data integration for Intermountain's research programs.

blocks.heading: Mental health and substance use disorder AI
paragraphs: Utah has specific mental health demographics — the unique pressures facing Utah's LDS community create specific mental health patterns that Intermountain's behavioral health programs address. ML for behavioral health risk prediction requires Utah-specific calibration.

sections.title: Silicon Slopes SaaS and B2B AI
sections.description: For Qualtrics (Provo), Adobe (Lehi), and the dense SaaS ecosystem along the Wasatch Front.

blocks.heading: Experience management AI
paragraphs: ML for Qualtrics' experience management platform — predicting customer, employee, and product experience outcomes from survey and behavioral signal data.

blocks.heading: Customer analytics platform AI
paragraphs: ML features for the many B2B SaaS companies building CRM, marketing, and customer success platforms in Silicon Slopes.

blocks.heading: AI-powered product features
paragraphs: LLM integration and ML-powered product intelligence for Silicon Slopes' large SaaS product portfolio.

sections.title: Mining and Materials
sections.description: Utah is one of the US's most important mining states — copper, gold, coal, and rare earth minerals.

blocks.heading: Mineral production optimization
paragraphs: ML for Kennecott Utah Copper's (Bingham Canyon Mine, one of the world's largest open pit copper mines) production analytics — predicting ore grade variability, equipment failure, and haul truck routing optimization.

blocks.heading: Mining safety analytics
paragraphs: ML for predictive safety in underground and open pit mining — predicting equipment failures before they create safety incidents.

sections.title: Outdoor Industry (Black Diamond Equipment, Traeger Grills)
sections.description: Black Diamond Equipment (SLC HQ, premier outdoor climbing and skiing gear) and the outdoor technology companies along the Wasatch Front.

blocks.heading: Outdoor gear demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for Black Diamond's seasonal equipment demand — alpine climbing gear demand peaks differ sharply from ski gear demand peaks, requiring separate demand models for the different outdoor recreation seasons that the Wasatch's world-class ski and climbing access creates.

blocks.heading: DTC eCommerce personalization
paragraphs: ML for the outdoor brands' growing DTC digital channels — product recommendation incorporating outdoor sport, experience level, and geographic context for outdoor enthusiasts.

sections.title: Silicon Slopes — The US's most underrated tech ecosystem
sections.description: Utah's Silicon Slopes technology corridor has produced technology companies at a per-capita rate that rivals any US geography except Silicon Valley.

blocks.heading: Qualtrics, Domo, and the SaaS generation
paragraphs: Qualtrics (acquired by SAP for $8B, then taken public at $18B) and Domo (BI platform, Utah-built) proved that enterprise SaaS companies of global significance can be built in Utah. This demonstration effect has attracted venture capital, technology talent, and entrepreneur confidence that is accelerating Silicon Slopes' growth.

blocks.heading: Utah's demographic technology advantage
paragraphs: Utah's younger-than-average population (the highest median household size in the US, driven by high birth rates), large bilingual LDS returned missionary community (Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin, Japanese, and Korean language skills at unusually high prevalence), and strong work ethic create a technology workforce with characteristics that differentiate Salt Lake City from other US tech hubs.

blocks.heading: Adobe's Utah AI investment
paragraphs: Adobe's large Lehi, Utah engineering operations — including significant AI engineering for Adobe Firefly and Creative Cloud AI features — represent a technology transfer from Silicon Valley to Silicon Slopes that is raising Utah's AI engineering sophistication considerably.
